facts.claim: The study explicitly deposits its FZD3 CRD–Nb8 crystal complex as 8Q7O. It separately deposits FZD3–Nb9 as 8QW4/EMD-18680.
Wild-type full-length human FZD3 is Q9NPG1 residues 1–666; this full-length construct was used for functional assays.
Multidomain production uses FZD3 residues 26–517 with C-terminal Rhinovirus 3C cleavage site, monoVenus, and Twin-Strep tag. CRD production uses residues 26–138 and the same tagging scheme.
Crystallization production coexpresses tagged FZD3 CRD and untagged Nb8 through lentiviral transduction in HEK293S GnTI- suspension cells.
CRD–Nb8 complex purification from conditioned medium uses Strep-Tactin; on-column 3C protease and endoglycosidase F1 treatment precede size-exclusion chromatography.
Nanobody discovery starts with one immunized llama; sequence analysis places Nb8 in enriched family 2.

unresolved: The selected primary sections call the 8Q7O binder Nb8, not 14478; deposited alias and exact sequence must be reconciled independently.

Methods define the CRD residue range and precursor tags, but do not state the complete post-cleavage deposited polymer string; exact sequence and residual-tag reconciliation remain for the parent metadata audit.
